claims.text: Bybit launched trading in 1,000+ U.S. stocks and ETFs for eligible KYC users, paid in USDC, on 12 October 2026.
Orders are executed, cleared and custodied by Alpaca Securities LLC, a FINRA/SIPC member; the introducing broker is Infra Capital Limited, regulated by the FSC Mauritius (GB23202169).
Zero commission, 24/5 trading including pre-market and after-hours, fractional shares, dividends in USDC, voting rights later.
Bybit listed TradFi perpetuals as recently as 9 October 2026.

seo.title: Bybit Stocks: Buy U.S. Stocks and ETFs With USDC, Explained
seo.description: Bybit launched trading in 1,000+ U.S. stocks and ETFs for USDC on 12 October 2026, custodied by Alpaca Securities; here is what you own, the zero-commission terms and what to check.

aeo.directAnswer: Since 12 October 2026 eligible Bybit users who completed KYC can buy more than 1,000 U.S. stocks and ETFs with USDC. Unlike tokenized stocks or TradFi perpetuals, the product gives an economic interest in the underlying shares, which are executed, cleared and held in custody by Alpaca Securities (FINRA/SIPC member) through Mauritius-regulated introducing broker Infra Capital; trading is commission-free and runs 24/5, dividends are paid in USDC and voting rights come later.
